runtime_compatibility.backend: torch compatibility; official TE unfused RoPE arithmetic
runtime_compatibility.rope_angle_precision: FP32 cos/sin then cast to q/k dtype

known_reference.comparison: Exact complete physical trace, normalized/environment controls, recorded joint-latent RMS, simulator array dtype/shape/bytes and initial/final PNG; exclude timings, memory, output paths and runtime-placement provenance only. Record placement difference; no full-backend equivalence claim.
known_reference.mismatch_policy: Preserve actual episode and report parity failure, without silent tuning/retry or relabeling the known pair as new. The unchanged native runner does not automatically halt on external parity audit; disclose any continuation and discrepancy.

N1.selection: single joint policy proposal; joint future is not scored

N2.selection: native argmax value, first candidate on exact tie

conditioning.goals: Original benchmark Goal throughout; physical environment and success predicate fixed.

analysis.primary_panel: All30 fixed pairs including failures; do not select tasks by outcome.
analysis.new_evidence_panel: Report new29 excluding task0/init0, and known1 separately. N2 outcomes were known at registration; this is a development comparison.
primary_outcomes: paired N2 gains (N1 failure/N2 success) and losses (N1 success/N2 failure)
secondary_outcomes: actual environment steps for every episode
steps-to-success null for failures; successful-both step differences with selection limitation
failure-penalized completion cost = actual steps if successful, 300 if failed; disclose early terminal failures
analysis.prefix_audit: Compare initial/settled state arrays and initial PNG, then find first different executed action. At every common chunk-query prefix up to that divergence compare N1 controls with N2 candidate0 seed31. After executed-action divergence contexts may differ; later differences are not fixed-candidate flips. Do not compare joint future RMS to AR forecast RMS. No complete query-input latent/hash archive exists, so claim only recorded shared-prefix evidence.
analysis.prefix_fields_available: All N2 candidates save environment controls, seed and value; per-candidate normalized controls are absent. Compare normalized controls only when candidate0 is selected and its normalized_actions are stored at chunk level.
analysis.incomplete_policy: Any missing episode/runtime error/non-completed source remains incomplete with no complete-panel contribution verdict. Invalid provenance/artifacts invalidate analysis, never become task failures.
analysis.decision_rule: No new success-count/effect-size gate. Describe contribution after all30 valid completed episodes; null result is not equivalence.
analysis.uncertainty: Task is cluster:10 tasks x3 init. Any bootstrap/sign-flip is exploratory development uncertainty, not 30 independent tasks.
analysis.future_attack_control: Any new mechanism needs separate preregistration and original-task utility loss against its N1 control; this comparison alone is no attack evidence.

causal_limits: N1 versus N2 changes candidate count, compute and forecast/value selection together; not pure causal isolation of future prediction.
Pinned torch adapter; full original Transformer Engine parity unestablished.
N1 still jointly generates a future, although no AR forecast/value ranking is used; do not call it world-model-free.
No Bus-Cut, poisoning, external attack interface, universal Goal-invariance or revision of old cyclic decision.

runtime_requirements.ALPHABRAIN_USE_NATIVE_TE: unset or not 1; frozen torch shim

references_exclude: MP4 visualization only; scientific PNG/NPZ/JSON/JSONL included.
